title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Notice Handling Charge on Repeated Arrears
content:
## Collections schedule

A notice handling charge is added to the charge a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record earns on instalments left unpaid, according to how often the agreement has already been charged for instalments left unpaid. The count is of the charges of that kind already standing on the agreement.

| Charges for instalments left unpaid already standing on the agreement | Notice handling charge added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the third notice handling charge, 60.00 USD |
| 1 or 2 | the second notice handling charge, 25.00 USD |
| none | no notice handling charge |

### Schedule notes

- The step turns on the count of charges of that kind already standing on the agreement, not on the amount of any of them.
- At a count of exactly 3 the third notice handling charge of 60.00 USD is added; at a count of exactly 2 the second notice handling charge of 25.00 USD is added.
- Where no such charge stands on the agreement, nothing is added under this schedule.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

An agreement on which 2 charges for instalments left unpaid already stand takes the second notice handling charge, 25.00 USD. Where a third such charge already stood, the figure would be the third notice handling charge, 60.00 USD.
